items.t: Nike Is Down About 80% From Its Peak and Just Told Investors Sales Will Fall Again
items.sum: Nike's stock has collapsed from its highs, analysts still show a 30% upside gap, and management just guided earnings far below what Wall Street expected. The math behind those price targets tells a very different story.

items.t: What Would Warren Buffett Do With Nike Stock Down 79% From Its Peak?
items.sum: The Oracle of Omaha would probably agree that sentiment toward this business is characterized by extreme uncertainty.

items.t: A $300,000 Portfolio in Kimco Realty, Eversource and Nike Pays $13,643 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.sum: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical $300,000 portfolio split evenly across Kimco Realty, Eversource Energy and Nike pays about $1,140 a month in dividends at today’s prices. Eversource’s dividend is the best covered of the three, at 63% of normalized EPS in fiscal 2025, and Kimco paid out 80% of its AFFO that year.
